snippet.title: Where the Seeds Fall - Reveal Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Where the Seeds Fall is the debut title from CygamesEdge, a new label from Cygames, coming November 5, 2026 to PlayStation 5.
  
The earth has been afflicted with Blight, forcing humanity to build new homes upon the branches of the World Tree.
  
It is a place fraught with peril, and in their fear, humanity has branded ""Fell Children"" as omens of disaster. After encountering a Fell Child, however, one soldier goes against orders and determines to escort them to the surface world.
  
Descend the World Tree by navigating ruins, reading the wind, and taking leaps of faith in this thrilling action-adventure game.
